changes.title: Treehouse north
items: The treehouse now stands due north of the dancefloor, just outside its ring of speakers, facing the floor
At the start the ley line runs from the treehouse's front straight south across the dancefloor, then curves off to the first soundsystem

changes.title: Feature sounds
items: Home's meadow is alive with sound: birdsong, bees and a breeze, fading out at home's edge

Ready for what's coming: a thump and whoosh when your witch is knocked back (and a dizzy twinkle while she's stunned), a charging legend's bellow, thundering hooves, rumble and skid, and a magical chime when you find a relic bottle

changes.title: Wave1 youth
items: Every area now starts with one young and one adult (was a baby and two adults), so the first areas you land in are easier to invite; they still grow by one creature a wave while wild
